title: Braking continuations miss. The independent planner is not qualified.
summary: All 25 discarded braking roots and 24 retained roots yield bounded misses. After correcting a terminal-time defect, released OMPL control RRT completes 0/4 feasible development cases. Its 97 partial-path states and full masks pass independent replay.
boundary: Fixed exposed cases and custom physical/control adapters. The first RRT qualification is retained as invalid. Four corrected runs exhaust 18,000 attempts each. These results establish neither infeasibility nor superiority. No new native driving.
next: Isolate the independent planner’s local control sampler on known executable continuations, including braking and waiting. Keep constraints and per-transition accounting fixed; qualify before returning to the source case.
